narrative.overview: The user-pinned black, dark glass, and orange reference establishes the visual authority. Near-black architectural surfaces, subtle borders, generous spacing, and restrained animation support a concrete professional offer. Manrope supplies both large headlines and compact labels; pill actions and softly rounded panels recur throughout.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black surfaces and muted orange accents.
Generous section spacing with compact supporting text.
dos: Do reuse the implemented palette, Manrope, pill actions, and 16px panels.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
Do keep scope explicit and imagery abstract when identity evidence is absent.
donts: Do not substitute a new visual world for the user-pinned reference.
Do not invent credentials, testimonials, client logos, or contact identity.
Do not turn subtle glass into heavy shadows or ornamental motion.
